title: Experience is not an intrinsic property of matter

statements.text: Unlike panpsychist readings of Russell, Whitehead’s process-relational view does not make experience a primary attribute or intrinsic property of matter, since physics has moved beyond the substance-property ontology in which such properties made sense. Energy and experience are both activities with fuzzy boundaries.

sources.quote: Whitehead’s processrelational rendering doesn’t claim experience is a ‘primary attribute’ or ‘intrinsic property’ of matter
